# Aalborg Børne- og Ungeafdeling

Aalborg Børne- og Ungeafdeling (Aalborg Department of Children and Youth) is a pediatric and adolescent unit within the Danish IBD monitoring system. The unit has achieved 38% compliance with indicator 1b for complete IBD diagnostic workup in children and youth — a result substantially below the national development target [^src1].

Indicator 1b measures complete diagnostic investigation of newly diagnosed inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) patients in the pediatric and adolescent population, requiring gastroskopy, koloskopy, and MR-scanning or capsule endoscopy. Across Denmark, only 69% of cases meet this target, meaning Aalborg's 38% performance represents significant underperformance at the departmental level [^src1]. The unit's compliance data comes from the DANIBD registry, which monitors diagnostic workup for IBD across Danish hospitals and regions. By contrast, indicator 1a (koloskopy-based investigation of adult IBD patients) has achieved the national development target of 79% across Denmark, highlighting that pediatric diagnostic standards present a particular challenge [^src1].

The gap between Aalborg's performance and the national benchmark suggests either systematic barriers to complete pediatric workup or variation in how the unit prioritizes or schedules the full diagnostic protocol. The DANIBD registry plans to re-evaluate this indicator during the next audit cycle in 2026, which will provide an opportunity to assess whether compliance has improved [^src1].
